commits.subject: feat(live-forward): research-only forecast capture on no-pick skip days (D8)
commits.body:
Season-wrap owner decision D8 (2026-09-14): keep a separately labeled forecast
stream once the tail policy stops producing picks (9/19 at contest streak 0).
The live-forward capture idled at pending_pick on every skip day (11 of 79
decision days since 5/09 have no ranked slate for exactly this reason).

live_forward_capture_once.py --capture-research-on-skip: on a day with no pick
file where scheduler_state.json carries a CURRENT skip intent
(final_skip_candidate; skip_notified_at alone is history) and decision.json is
not scoreable, export the ranked slates into a SEPARATE research root
(data/validation/decision_weighted_lgbm_v0_live_forward_research/<date>), verify
them without the pick-snapshot requirement, and publish in two phases: sidecar
research_capture.json (hashes, identity, provenance, timestamps) written last
and atomically, then an acceptance marker whose published_at is sampled AFTER
the sidecar rename. Guards: research root may not overlap the official root,
picks dir, data dir or production root; per-date dir may not be a symlink or
escape the root; start before first pitch - 5 min and every publication sample
before first pitch, else quarantined to <date>.late.*; partial/corrupt/
unaccepted dirs quarantined to <date>.partial.* and redone only pregame; all
reads side-effect-free (never load_state). Restart validation re-checks
schema, labels, hashes, manifest identity + git_commit binding, verification
ok, start cutoff, completion ordering and the acceptance marker; a complete
capture for another candidate is reported incompatible and left untouched.
Official #16 stream, decision.json, delivery and contest state are untouched;
flag off is byte-identical. Unit ExecStart gains the flag.

Codex (gpt-6-astra xhigh) design review + 3 code rounds; final verdict SIGN.
34 new tests (48 in file).
